FIELD.name: ArchiveFileID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ArchiveFileID

FIELD.name: fileSetName
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Data set name

FIELD.name: ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Right ascension at the center of the image or skycell, in degrees.

FIELD.name: dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Declination at the center of the image or skycell, in degrees.

FIELD.name: exposure_type
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: exposure type - type of data in the exposure

FIELD.name: exposure_time
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The difference in time (in units of seconds) between the start of the first reset/read and end of the last read in the readout pattern.

FIELD.name: program
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ID number (integer) assigned to the proposal (e.g. 1012, 12045)

FIELD.name: visit_start_time
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The UTC time at the beginning of the visit. The time is serialized on disk as an International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 8601-compliant ISOT string, but if opened in Python with the asdf-astropy package installed, it may be read as an astropy.time.Time object with all of the associated methods and transforms available. See the documentation for astropy.time.Time objects for more information.

FIELD.name: program_subcategory
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The submitted proposal subcategory of the program. The subcategories include calibration (CAL), coronagraph technology demonstration (CGI), community research programs (CR), discretionary research programs (DR), Galactic Bulge Time Domain Survey (GBTD), High-Latitude Time Domain Survey (HLTD), High-Latitude Wide-Area Survey (HLWA), observational research program (OR), Wide Field Instrument (WFI), and Wavefront Sensing and Control (WFSC). All subcategories belong to only a subset of the meta.program.category values.

FIELD.name: program_category
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The submitted proposal category of the program. The categories include calibration (CAL), core community survey (CCS), coronagraph technology demonstration (CGI), observatory commissioning (COM), engineering (ENG), general astrophysics survey (GAS), general investigator (GI), and observing conducted at the direction of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).

FIELD.name: effective_exposure_time
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The difference in time (in units of seconds) between the midpoints of the first and last science resultants. If either resultant contains only a single read, then the time at the end of the read is used rather than the midpoint time.

FIELD.name: calibration_software_version
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The version of the calibration software used to generate the product

FIELD.name: dataset_category
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Associated category of this dataset. e.g., detector, skycell, microlensing, or spectra

FIELD.name: productLevel
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Product level: 1 = uncalibrated detector data (e.g. ramps), 2 = calibrated detector rate images, 3 = re-pixellated data including co-additions and mosaics, 4 = information extracted from pixel-level data (e.g., source catalogs, 1-D extracted spectra, and light curves)

FIELD.name: program_title
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Program Title

FIELD.name: exposure_start_time
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The time in UTC at the beginning of the exposure, or the start of the first observation of a combined product.

FIELD.name: segment
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Identifier for the segment. A segment is the sequence of activities produced by each iteration of an Astronomer's Proposal Tool (APT) segment plan in a pass. A segment may include multiple traversals of mosaic pattern(s), with element wheel moves occurring between observations. The allowed range of segment numbers is 001 to 999 inclusive.

FIELD.name: origin
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The name of the institution or organization responsible for creating this file.

FIELD.name: optical_element
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the optical element used to take the science data.

FIELD.name: detector
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the Wide Field Instrument (WFI) detector used to take the science data in this file.

FIELD.name: good_pixel_fraction
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The fraction of pixels in the output image that are considered good.

FIELD.name: image_median
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Median image value in units of megaJanskys per steradian (MJy/sr).

FIELD.name: image_rms
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Mean absolute deviation of the image values in units of data numbers per second (DN/s).

FIELD.name: pa_aperture
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Position angle in degrees of the aperture ideal Y axis relative to the V3 axis of the spacecraft. This information comes from the Science Instrument Aperture File (SIAF) in the Science Operations Center (SOC) Project Reference Database (PRD).

FIELD.name: pa_v3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The position angle of the V3 axis (in units of degrees) is defined as the projection of the V3 axis on the sky measured from North to East. The telescope V coordinate system is defined with its origin at the vertex of the primary mirror. The +V3 axis is defined to be orthogonal to the sunshield. See Roman-STScI-000143 'Description of the Roman SIAF and Coordinate Frames' for more information.

FIELD.name: roll_ref
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Position angle of the telescope V3 axis at the reference pixel position measured from North to East. The telescope V coordinate system is defined with its origin at the vertex of the primary mirror. The +V3 axis is orthogonal to the sunshield. See Roman-STScI-000143 'Description of the Roman SIAF and Coordinate Frames' for more information.

FIELD.name: spatial_x
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: X barycentric coordinate of the Roman observatory at the MJD described by meta.ephemeris.time.

FIELD.name: spatial_y
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Y barycentric coordinate of the Roman observatory at the MJD described by meta.ephemeris.time.

FIELD.name: spatial_z
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Z barycentric coordinate of the Roman observatory at the MJD described by meta.ephemeris.time.

FIELD.name: visit_exptime
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure time in seconds

FIELD.name: search_key
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Search Key
